metadata.name: Reactive Resume v6
metadata.description: Reactive Resume v6 resume builder. This is a new app, separate from Reactive Resume v5. v6 stores uploads on a local volume, renders PDFs in the app, and bundles PostgreSQL 18. It does not include MinIO, Redis, or Browserless. Do not attach it to a v5 database volume. A v5 database migration is one-way, and PostgreSQL 18 cannot open the v5 data directory.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

ports.description: Container Port: 3000 (host port 3028 so it does not collide with Reactive Resume v5 on 3000)

before_install.en_us:
NEW APP - REACTIVE RESUME V6

This is a NEW app, separate from 'reactive-resume' (v5.3.2). Do not treat the install as an upgrade of an existing v5 stack.

FOR NEW USERS:
- Install this app for new Reactive Resume v6 deployments
- APP_URL is http://localhost:3028. Change it if you open the app from another device. It must match the address in the browser
- Web UI is on host port 3028
- Uploads live in the reactive-resume-v6_data volume, mounted at /app/data

FOR REACTIVE RESUME V5 USERS:
- Do NOT uninstall the existing 'reactive-resume' app
- Do NOT point this app at the v5 PostgreSQL volume or the v5 MinIO volume
- v6 drops database columns that v5 still reads. Starting v6 on that database is one-way
- This app bundles PostgreSQL 18. That image cannot open the v5 data directory
- v5 pictures live in MinIO. A database dump does not move them. Copy uploads into /app/data, or configure S3 yourself, after you have a backup
- Chrome, MinIO, and Redis are not part of this app. v6 renders PDFs itself

Upgrade guide: https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/upgrading-to-v6
